title: FA3 integration sanity & decode-schedule sanity harness
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Background: We are onboarding FlashAttention v3 codepaths to the serving runtime to capture throughput gains on long-context decoding. Previous attempts introduced intermittent latency regressions for mixed-precision sequences and for small-batch prefill workloads. This ticket builds a focused sanity harness and orchestration guard that exercises FA2->FA3 kernel switching at prefill/decode boundaries with deterministic inputs, collects targeted telemetry, and codifies rollout/rollback criteria.

Scope:
- Implement a deterministic harness that simulates realistic prefill+decode flows across sequence lengths (128/512/2048) and batch mixes (1-8).
- Add lightweight scheduler validations to the runtime to detect oscillation when switching between FA2 and FA3 kernels within the same request lifecycle.
- Produce a telemetry dashboard that surfaces 95/99th latency deltas, token throughput, CUDA kernel launch errors, and workspace allocation spikes.
- Define automated canary gating rules for 0%, 10%, 30% progressive rollouts and immediate rollback triggers.

Acceptance criteria:
- Harness can be run locally and in CI; nightly job runs across GPU families (A100, H100) without flakiness.
- No regressions in 95/99 latency vs baseline (<= +2% allowed) for canary loads, and no increase in workspace allocation failures.
- Scheduler detects and logs kernel oscillation events; test coverage for detection logic included.
- Clear rollout playbook added and reviewed by runtime and reliability leads.

Test plan:
- Unit tests for kernel switching logic and scheduler backoff.
- End-to-end runner that replays production traces (anonymized) against FA2-only, FA3-only, and mixed strategies.
- A/B performance harness that computes token/sec and latency distributions, storing results to the perf bucket for diffing.
- Introduce an ephemeral dedicated cluster job for a 24-hour soak with 10% of internal traffic.

Telemetry & metrics to capture:
- request_id, model_variant, kernel_choice_history (comma-separated), prefill_latency_ms, decode_latency_ms, total_tokens, alloc_retry_count, cuda_error_count, workspace_bytes_peak, queue_depth_histogram.
- Alert if alloc_retry_count > 0.1% over 1h or if 99th latency increases by >5% during canary.

Risk & trade-offs:
- Extra instrumentation increases per-request overhead (~0.2-0.6%); limited to canary clusters and debug builds.
- Conservative backoff may lose some FA3 tail performance; trade toward stability for initial rollout.

Rollout plan:
- Dev cluster: run harness and iterate (DONE).
- Internal nightly canary: 0% -> 10% (48h) -> 30% (72h) with telemetry gates.
- External canary: 10% incumbent customer internal traffic for 24h (opt-in).
- Full rollout only after 72h soak with no gate violations or customer-impact events.

Rollback criteria:
- >0.5% increase in alloc_retry_count or >5% increase in 99th latency for two consecutive 1h windows triggers immediate rollback.

Deliverables:
- harness/run_fa_switcher.sh and CI job: runtime-fa3-san-harness.
- telemetry dashboard (perf/fa3-integration-sanity).
- scheduler logic and unit tests under runtime/scheduler/fa_switch_guard.*
- rollout playbook doc linked in comments.

Owners: Marco Ruiz (primary), Aisha Kumar (runtime lead), Sima Patel (reliability), Daniel Ho (benchmarks)
comments: 2025-02-14: Ticket created after sprint grooming. Decision to separate harness from full runtime rollout to limit blast radius.

2025-02-17: Prototype harness able to replay anonymized trace: see PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4832 (proto). Initial runs show FA3 token/sec +13% on H100 for long-context 2048 sequence but 95p latency jitter on mixed batches.

2025-02-20: Added kernel_choice_history field to telemetry. Observed oscillation pattern when prefill uses FA3 and first decode step falls back to FA2 for tiny microbatches — scheduler lacked hysteresis.
2025-02-22: Implemented ephemeral backoff (150ms) and a kernel sticky window metric. Unit tests added. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4891 for guard logic.

2025-02-25: Nightly run across A100/H100 in CI. FA3 stable for pure long-prefill, but mixed workload still shows rare workspace allocation retries on A100. Engineering investigating quantization alignment and workspace rounding differences.

2025-02-27: Sima ran perf A/B against 10k trace samples. Summary parked in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/perf/fa3_sanity_20250227.xlsx. Recommendation: keep backoff and add a per-GPU threshold for FA3 selection (memory headroom check).
2025-03-01: Added canary gating rules to the playbook and drafted alerting thresholds. Marcos requested a second opinion from Security for telemetry fields (no PII expected).
2025-03-03: Preparing for internal 10% canary rollout. CI job green for 48h local reruns. Next: schedule 24h soak on canary cluster and notify on-call.
